about: Achievements for Berlin's sights (docs/02-architecture.md, "Achievements"). Each rule picks its sights: by categories, era (of the year built, BerlinHistory), architect, commissionedBy, styles, district, or an explicit list (sights); include / exclude adjust a selection; count / all are milestones over all sights. Station rules (places: stations, line, system) pick U-Bahn and S-Bahn stations, collected by going there; a line's stations in its order. Achievements whose rule picks fewer than two sights are left out. Places of remembrance (memorials, memorial sites, cemeteries) are not part of the game: no achievement asks for them.

achievements.title: First Steps
achievements.description: Capture your first sight. Berlin is best discovered on foot.

achievements.title: Flâneur
achievements.description: Capture 10 sights – stroll, look around, let the city surprise you.

achievements.title: Kiez Explorer
achievements.description: Capture 25 sights, well beyond the guidebook classics.

achievements.title: Berlin Insider
achievements.description: Capture 50 sights. You now know Berlin better than many Berliners.

achievements.title: Living Chronicle
achievements.description: Capture 100 sights – eight centuries of history, walked.

achievements.title: Ich bin ein Berliner
achievements.description: Capture every sight. John F. Kennedy said it at Rathaus Schöneberg in 1963 – now you have earned it.

achievements.title: Bells of Berlin
achievements.description: Visit every church, from the medieval Nikolaikirche to the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church.

achievements.title: Fountain Hunter
achievements.description: Find all the fountains: Neptune at the Rotes Rathaus, the fairy tales of Friedrichshain, the bulls of Prenzlauer Berg, the “Wasserklops” and more.

achievements.title: Market Day
achievements.description: Shop like a Berliner: the market halls of the 1880s, Hackescher Markt, the city's biggest weekly market on Winterfeldtplatz – and the Gendarmenmarkt, once a market square.

achievements.title: Museum Marathon
achievements.description: Every museum on the map – antiquity, art, technology, natural history and the Allies in the divided city.

achievements.title: Curtain Up
achievements.description: Opera, concert halls and open-air stages: where Berlin goes out at night.

achievements.title: Club Culture
achievements.description: Berlin's club culture – its techno culture has been on Germany's list of intangible cultural heritage since 2024: Berghain, Tresor, the KitKatClub, SO36, the Kater on the Spree, the Club der Visionaere and a dance hall of 1913.

achievements.title: Live in Berlin
achievements.description: Where the bands play: the arenas, the Columbiahalle and the Tempodrom, an old beer palace, a punk club and the two great open-air stages.

achievements.title: Game Day
achievements.description: Where Berlin plays: the Olympic stadium, Union's Alte Försterei, the arenas of the Volleys, Füchse, Eisbären and Alba, the Velodrom of the Six Days and the regatta course.

achievements.title: Palace Hopper
achievements.description: The palaces, castles and hunting lodges of the Hohenzollern and their court.

achievements.title: Berlin from Above
achievements.description: Climb the towers and hills and see the city from above.

achievements.title: Green Berlin
achievements.description: Parks, gardens, lakes and both zoos – and Berlin's oldest tree. Berlin is one of Europe's greenest cities.

achievements.title: Seats of Power
achievements.description: Where Germany and Berlin are governed: the Bundestag, the chancellery, the president's palace, the Bundesrat, the city's parliament, its town hall and a ministry with a dark past.

achievements.title: Town Hall Tour
achievements.description: Berlin used to be many towns and villages until Greater Berlin was formed in 1920. Visit the town halls of Berlin, Charlottenburg, Schöneberg, Rixdorf (Neukölln), Köpenick, Spandau, Lichtenberg and Pankow.

achievements.title: Squares and Plazas
achievements.description: Berlin's great squares, from Baroque Gendarmenmarkt to socialist Alexanderplatz and rebuilt Potsdamer Platz.

achievements.title: Border Bridges
achievements.description: Two bridges that were border crossings in the Cold War: the Oberbaumbrücke between Kreuzberg and Friedrichshain, and the Glienicke Bridge, where spies were exchanged.

achievements.title: Two Zoos, One City
achievements.description: West Berlin had the Zoologischer Garten of 1844; East Berlin opened its own Tierpark in 1955. Visit both.

achievements.title: Museum Island
achievements.description: All five museums on the island in the Spree, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

achievements.title: World Heritage
achievements.description: Berlin's UNESCO World Heritage: Museum Island, the palaces and parks on the Havel, and the six modernist housing estates of 1913–1934.

achievements.title: Light, Air and Sun
achievements.description: The six Berlin Modernism Housing Estates (UNESCO World Heritage): homes for workers with light, air, gardens and colour, instead of dark tenement courtyards.

achievements.title: Under the Lime Trees
achievements.description: Walk Berlin's grand boulevard Unter den Linden, from the Brandenburg Gate to the palace.

achievements.title: Berlin's Finest Square
achievements.description: The Gendarmenmarkt ensemble: the square, Schinkel's Konzerthaus and the French and German churches with their twin domed towers.

achievements.title: Old Fritz
achievements.description: What Frederick the Great (1740–1786) had built: his opera, the Catholic cathedral, the forum around them, a palace for his brother, the domed towers on the Gendarmenmarkt and the Hackescher Markt.

achievements.title: Along the Wall
achievements.description: Trace the line of the Berlin Wall (1961–1989): the gate in no man's land, Potsdamer Platz, the checkpoint, the longest painted stretch, the border bridge and the death strip turned park. The Wall Memorial on Bernauer Straße is a place of remembrance, outside the game.

achievements.title: Spy City
achievements.description: Cold War Berlin: the airfields of the Airlift, the Allies, a listening station on a rubble mountain, the bridge of spy swaps and the checkpoint in Friedrichstraße.

achievements.title: Socialist Showcase
achievements.description: The GDR's grand projects for its capital: the palaces for workers on Stalinallee and the new Alexanderplatz under the TV tower.

achievements.title: Olympic Grounds 1936
achievements.description: The venues of the 1936 Olympics, which the Nazi regime staged as propaganda: Werner March's stadium, bell tower and open-air stage, and the regatta course in Grünau.

achievements.title: Under the Open Sky
achievements.description: Berlin's two great open-air stages: the Waldbühne of 1936 in the West and the Parkbühne Wuhlheide of 1951 in the East.

achievements.title: The Olympics That Never Were
achievements.description: Built for Berlin's bid for the 2000 Olympics, which went to Sydney: the Velodrom and the Max-Schmeling-Halle.

achievements.title: Parliament Neighbours
achievements.description: Friedrich Schulze built both houses of the Prussian parliament back to back – today the Bundesrat and Berlin's House of Representatives.

achievements.title: Peak Bagger
achievements.description: Berlin is flat? Climb its hills: the Kreuzberg, the rubble mountains of Teufelsberg and Humboldthöhe, the Kienberg and the Müggelberge.

achievements.title: Lakeside Berlin
achievements.description: Summer by the water: the lidos on the Wannsee, the Müggelsee and the Plötzensee, the Peacock Island, the Tegeler See, and the small lakes of Weißensee and Hohenschönhausen.

achievements.title: Cleared for Take-off
achievements.description: Berlin's airfields, all closed now: Johannisthal, Germany's first (1909), Tempelhof, Gatow of the Royal Air Force, and Tegel with its hexagonal terminal.

achievements.title: Up North in Wedding
achievements.description: The old workers' district north of the centre: a flak tower turned hill, a people's park, Schinkel's church on Leopoldplatz, the lido on the Plötzensee and Bruno Taut's estate by the Schillerpark.

achievements.title: Medieval Roots
achievements.description: The oldest things in Berlin: churches built while Berlin, Cölln and Spandau were young trading towns, Spandau's old quarter – and an oak said to have sprouted before them.

achievements.title: The Electors' Residence
achievements.description: Built under the Hohenzollern electors of Brandenburg (1415–1701): a fortress, a hunting lodge, the Friedrichstadt, the arsenal and the first Baroque palaces.

achievements.title: Royal Prussia
achievements.description: Everything built in the Kingdom of Prussia (1701–1871): Baroque and Rococo, then Schinkel's Neoclassical capital.

achievements.title: Imperial Capital
achievements.description: Built in the German Empire (1871–1918), when Berlin grew into a city of millions.

achievements.title: Golden Twenties
achievements.description: The Weimar Republic (1918–1933): radio towers, modernist housing and Mies van der Rohe.

achievements.title: Capital of the GDR
achievements.description: Built in East Berlin between 1949 and 1990.

achievements.title: Island City
achievements.description: Built in West Berlin between 1949 and 1990, an island of the West in the middle of the GDR.

achievements.title: New Berlin
achievements.description: Built since reunification in 1990, when Berlin became the capital again.

achievements.title: Baroque Splendour
achievements.description: Every Baroque building: palaces, churches and the arsenal of the first Prussian kings.

achievements.title: Temples of Classicism
achievements.description: Columns, porticoes and Greek temples: every Neoclassical building, the style that made Berlin “Athens on the Spree”.

achievements.title: Red Brick Berlin
achievements.description: Brick Gothic, medieval and revived: from the oldest churches to Schwechten's towers and the Oberbaumbrücke.

achievements.title: Modernists
achievements.description: Glass, steel and concrete: every Modernist building, from Mies van der Rohe to the TV tower.

achievements.title: Schinkel's Berlin
achievements.description: Karl Friedrich Schinkel shaped Prussia's capital like no other architect: a museum, a theatre, a monument, country houses and a church for the new suburbs.

achievements.title: Frederick's Architect
achievements.description: Georg Wenzeslaus von Knobelsdorff built for his friend Frederick the Great: the opera, the cathedral, the forum, a palace for Prince Henry and a wing of Charlottenburg Palace.

achievements.title: Baroque Beginnings
achievements.description: Johann Arnold Nering planned the Friedrichstadt and began the arsenal and the palaces of Brandenburg's last elector – the first Prussian king – and his court.

achievements.title: Schinkel's Heir
achievements.description: Friedrich August Stüler, Schinkel's pupil: two museums, a church in Russian style and the golden dome of the New Synagogue.

achievements.title: Palace Builder
achievements.description: Johann Friedrich Eosander von Göthe, court architect of the first Prussian king, built palaces for the royal family.

achievements.title: Halls of Plenty
achievements.description: Hermann Blankenstein, Berlin's city architect, built the market halls that fed the growing city – and the towers of its oldest church.

achievements.title: The City's Architect
achievements.description: Ludwig Hoffmann, city architect for almost thirty years: the Märkisches Museum, the Fairy Tale Fountain and the Pergamon Museum.

achievements.title: Romantic Brick
achievements.description: Franz Schwechten's medieval dreams in brick and stone: the memorial church, the Grunewald tower and a brewery like a castle.

achievements.title: Henselmann's Boulevard
achievements.description: Hermann Henselmann, the GDR's star architect: the towers of the Stalinallee and the first design of the TV tower.

achievements.title: Taut's Colours
achievements.description: Bruno Taut built homes for workers with gardens, light and bold colours – four of his estates are World Heritage.

achievements.title: Heart of the City
achievements.description: Every sight in Mitte, from the medieval centre to the government quarter, Moabit and Wedding.

achievements.title: Both Banks of the Spree
achievements.description: Friedrichshain and Kreuzberg, East and West until 1990, joined by the Oberbaumbrücke – and the heart of Berlin's nights, from SO36 to Berghain.

achievements.title: Prenzlauer Berg and Pankow
achievements.description: Prenzlauer Berg, Pankow and Weißensee: water tower, brewery, churches, the palace of the GDR's president, a lake, a park, the town hall, Bruno Taut's estate and two arenas built for the Olympic bid.

achievements.title: City West
achievements.description: Charlottenburg and Wilmersdorf: the palace, the Ku'damm area, the Olympic grounds, the Grunewald and Siemensstadt.

achievements.title: Older than Berlin
achievements.description: Spandau was a town before Berlin was: its citadel, its old quarter on the Kolk, its old church, its town hall, a hidden fort and the airfield of Gatow.

achievements.title: Villas and Lakes
achievements.description: Steglitz and Zehlendorf: villas on the Wannsee, the Peacock Island, the Botanic Garden and the bridge of spies.

achievements.title: Runways and Town Halls
achievements.description: Tempelhof and Schöneberg: the airport of the Airlift, the field it left behind, a concert hall built for US soldiers and the town hall of “Ich bin ein Berliner”.

achievements.title: From Rixdorf to Neukölln
achievements.description: Old Rixdorf's town hall and park, a manor, a garden show, the Horseshoe Estate and a beer palace of 1880.

achievements.title: Captain of Köpenick
achievements.description: Treptow and Köpenick: the town hall of the hoax of 1906, a water palace, an abandoned amusement park, the Olympic regatta course, Union's stadium, the Parkbühne, a waterworks, a lido, wind tunnels and a colourful garden city.

achievements.title: Gardens of the East
achievements.description: Marzahn and Hellersdorf: the Gardens of the World, the Kienberg, Biesdorf Palace, a windmill and a museum of the Gründerzeit.

achievements.title: Lichtenberg Unlocked
achievements.description: Lichtenberg: the Tierpark and its palace, a house by Mies van der Rohe, the town hall and the Orankesee.

achievements.title: Tegel Shores
achievements.description: Reinickendorf: Humboldt's palace, Tegel Airport, the White City, Berlin's oldest tree, the Borsig tower, the Tegeler See and a Buddhist house of the 1920s.

achievements.title: First Stop
achievements.description: Collect your first U-Bahn or S-Bahn station: walking past counts, so does riding through above ground.

achievements.title: Station Hopper
achievements.description: Collect 25 stations.

achievements.title: Commuter
achievements.description: Collect 100 stations – more than most Berliners ever see.

achievements.title: Every U-Bahn Station
achievements.description: Every station of the U-Bahn, from Alt-Tegel to Rudow and from Ruhleben to Hönow.

achievements.title: Every S-Bahn Station
achievements.description: Every station of the S-Bahn, out to Potsdam, Oranienburg, Bernau, Strausberg, Königs Wusterhausen and the airport.

achievements.title: Line U1
achievements.description: Collect every station of the U1, Uhlandstraße – Warschauer Straße – much of it on the viaduct of Berlin's first U-Bahn of 1902.

achievements.title: Line U2
achievements.description: Collect every station of the U2, Pankow – Ruhleben.

achievements.title: Line U3
achievements.description: Collect every station of the U3, Krumme Lanke – Warschauer Straße.

achievements.title: Line U4
achievements.description: Collect every station of the U4, Innsbrucker Platz – Nollendorfplatz – the shortest line, through Schöneberg.

achievements.title: Line U5
achievements.description: Collect every station of the U5, Hauptbahnhof – Hönow – since 2020 under Unter den Linden.

achievements.title: Line U6
achievements.description: Collect every station of the U6, Alt-Mariendorf – Alt-Tegel.

achievements.title: Line U7
achievements.description: Collect every station of the U7, Rudow – Rathaus Spandau – the longest line, underground all the way.

achievements.title: Line U8
achievements.description: Collect every station of the U8, Hermannstraße – Wittenau – under East Berlin past closed “ghost stations” while the city was divided.

achievements.title: Line U9
achievements.description: Collect every station of the U9, Osloer Straße – Rathaus Steglitz – West Berlin's north–south line, opened two weeks after the Wall went up.

achievements.title: Line S1
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S1, Oranienburg – Wannsee – through the north–south tunnel.

achievements.title: Line S15
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S15, Hauptbahnhof – Gesundbrunnen.

achievements.title: Line S2
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S2, Bernau – Blankenfelde.

achievements.title: Line S25
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S25, Hennigsdorf – Teltow Stadt.

achievements.title: Line S26
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S26, Teltow Stadt – Blankenburg.

achievements.title: Line S3
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S3, Erkner – Spandau.

achievements.title: Ringbahn
achievements.description: Every station of the Ringbahn (S41 clockwise, S42 anticlockwise), the 37-kilometre “Hundekopf” around the inner city.

achievements.title: Line S46
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S46, Königs Wusterhausen – Westend.

achievements.title: Line S47
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S47, Südkreuz – Spindlersfeld.

achievements.title: Line S5
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S5, Strausberg Nord – Westkreuz.

achievements.title: Line S7
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S7, Ahrensfelde – Potsdam Hauptbahnhof.

achievements.title: Line S75
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S75, Ostbahnhof – Wartenberg.

achievements.title: Line S8
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S8, Birkenwerder – Wildau.

achievements.title: Line S85
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S85, Frohnau – Flughafen BER.

achievements.title: Line S9
achievements.description: Collect every station of the S9, Flughafen BER – Spandau, right through the city centre.
